terms.gloss: a way out, an exit; a going out
evidence: Caes. BG 7.44: omnī exitū … interclūsī (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: Volō prope exitum sedēre, sī fierī potest.
phrases.english: I want to sit near an exit, if possible.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 212, 216.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
